note: Seamless-flythrough build. Each link is generated with MiniMax H3 using start_image = space A's photo and end_image = space B's photo, so consecutive links share a matching frame and concatenate with --fade 0 (no cuts). ~20 credits per link at 5s/2K.

Scene completely static: no people, bed and furniture unchanged, no warping of walls or geometry. Real-estate walkthrough footage.

gotchas: MiniMax H3 caps concurrent jobs — submit at most 2 at a time or the rest return 429; each 2K clip takes roughly 5-10 minutes.
kling3_0 is cheaper per clip (8.75 vs 20) and also supports end_image, but returns 403 on the Starter plan — it needs Pro or Ultimate.
Output ignores aspect_ratio and comes back 4:3-ish (e.g. 1920x1440, 2176x1440); stitch.py's scale-to-cover + centre-crop handles that to clean 1920x1080.
Foliage-heavy footage encodes large: crf 21 gave 46MB for 20s. Use watermark.py --crf 26 for a sendable preview.
